守密人、
    由於台服運營商官網域名更新中產生的意外技術問題，導致目前部分守密人使用台服PC包體登入時，可能出現無法載入最新資源的問題，報錯提示為【網路異常，請稍後重試】。
請遇到以上問題的守密人，透過官方網站下載最新PC安裝包，重新安裝後即可正常遊玩。
    非常抱歉以上問題帶來的不便，我們將為您發放補給物資【銀芯×200】，以表歉意！

Dear Keepers,

    Due to unexpected technical issues arising from a domain update on the official website for the Taiwan server, some Keepers may encounter problems loading the latest game assets when logging in via the PC client. The error message displayed reads: [Network error; please try again later].

If you are experiencing this issue, please download the latest PC installer from the official website and reinstall the game to resume normal play.

    We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused and would like to offer you a compensation package of [Silver Cores ×200] as a token of our apology.
